assay_or_perturbation: 2-AG stimulation and CB1/CB2 pharmacology; ERK/Fyn and AP-1 reporter assays
evidence_summary: 2-AG through CB1/CB2 was associated with ERK/Fyn signaling and increased AP-1 transcriptional output.
limitations: The evidence is a composite CB1/CB2 program and does not resolve receptor-specific target-gene regulation.

cell_type_or_model: adult mouse myenteric neurons and enteric nervous system
assay_or_perturbation: 5-HT4 agonists/antagonist; PKA inhibitor; pCREB; BrdU and neuronal precursor/neuronal-marker assays
evidence_summary: 5-HT4 stimulation activated CREB in cultured myenteric neurons and promoted enteric-neuron survival and adult neurogenesis in vivo.
limitations: The model is enteric rather than spinal and no single terminal CREB target gene was assigned.

assay_or_perturbation: 5-HT2A agonism; pCREB occupancy; CREB loss-of-function; Arc, Bdnf1 and Cebpb promoter assays
evidence_summary: 5-HT2A stimulation increased pCREB occupancy at Arc, Bdnf1 and Cebpb promoter elements, with CREB loss attenuating induction.
limitations: These are comparator target-promoter records and do not establish a single direct receptor-to-target molecular edge in SCI cells.

assay_or_perturbation: CXCL12 stimulation; CXCR4 knockdown; MEK/ERK and PI3K/AKT inhibitors; migration assays
evidence_summary: CXCL12 promoted OPC migration and activated MEK/ERK and PI3K/AKT; CXCR4 knockdown blocked both pathway activation and migration.
limitations: No terminal CREB/AP-1 or other TF target was established; the 20B LR row remains boundary/non-exportable.
